运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

安全损失为 56/9≈6.22222256/9\approx6.22222256/9≈6.222222⁠，以全部 12 个位置为分母的错误 mean 为 56/12≈4.66666756/12\approx4.66666756/12≈4.666667⁠；先对无效 NaN 计算误差再乘零会得到 NaN。有效标量数为 6，加权分母为 9，全部预测梯度与解析式一致。

python 04_losses_demo.py环境配置

安全的加权 Mask MSE：有效集合、分母与预测梯度

04_losses_demo.py
import torch torch.manual_seed(0)pred = torch.tensor([[[1., 2.], [3., 4.], [float("nan"), float("nan")]],                     [[2., 1.], [float("nan"), float("nan")],                      [float("nan"), float("nan")]]], requires_grad=True)valid = torch.tensor([[True, True, False], [True, False, False]])target = torch.where(valid[..., None], torch.zeros_like(pred),                     torch.full_like(pred, float("nan")))dim_weight = torch.tensor([1., 2.]) # STEP 1: 先构造实际有效集合，再做差与平方。weight = valid.unsqueeze(-1).to(pred.dtype) * dim_weightactive = weight > 0denominator = weight.sum()if denominator <= 0:    raise ValueError("没有正权重的有效监督")safe_pred = torch.where(active, pred, torch.zeros_like(pred))safe_target = torch.where(active, target, torch.zeros_like(target))error = safe_pred - safe_targetloss = (error.square() * weight).sum() / denominatorassert torch.allclose(loss, torch.tensor(56. / 9.)) # STEP 2: 两种错误独立验证：先计算 NaN 再乘零；使用 Padding 分母。unsafe_loss = ((pred - target).square() * weight).sum() / denominatorassert torch.isnan(unsafe_loss)wrong_mean = (error.square() * weight).mean()assert torch.allclose(wrong_mean, torch.tensor(56. / 12.)) # STEP 3: 直接按解析式核对全部预测梯度。loss.backward()expected_grad = 2 * error.detach() * weight / denominatortorch.testing.assert_close(pred.grad, expected_grad)assert torch.isfinite(pred.grad).all()assert torch.equal(pred.grad[~active], torch.zeros_like(pred.grad[~active]))print("正确损失:", loss.item(), "错误 Padding mean:", wrong_mean.item())print("有效标量数:", int(active.sum()), "加权分母:", denominator.item())
